─── Mechanical design block (designed before the prose) ─────────────
Crux            The foreign wool buyers at the staple fair have agreed to bid one low price,
and the wool guild has sent {actor} to break their ring and sell the town's clip.
Whose problem?  The agent's: sent by name by the wool guild, which will blame them if the
clip goes cheap. Scene-local; no prior tie asserted (prose rule 7).
Reach = theme?  Step 0 Gold 0.74 finds the buyer who will break the ring.
Step 1 Gold 0.80 sells the clip sack by sack at the weighing house.
Shape           Test & Consequence, linear. Step 0 continue_weakened (a step-0
critical_failure ends the action); step 1 fail_action with carryover lines
keyed on step 0, so the sale inherits how the ring broke.
Consequence hand (binding, THR-1145): possession + story_seed — no swap.
possession    step 1 successMetadata attachment_grant reward_vestments_merchant_silks on
$actor: the guild pays the master's fee in the dyed silk the foreign house
paid in kind. Existing possession template, used by no other encounter.
BOON item chip on cs / s / sac. The pledge: the cs / s reaction 'Sign the
mayor's contract' and the sac reaction 'Give the mayor the guild's pledge'
grant agreement.treaty.trade, counterparty $cast:mayor (must-persist).
story_seed    step 1 successMetadata encounter_seed templateId
encounter.town.bell_at_the_exchange (exists, drawable, gold, urban, opening
stands alone), placeless, delay 72, inheritContext. The ring's factor is
cast key `buyer`, the key the exchange binds its merchant-house buyer to, so
the inherited binding seats the same factor at the next bidding floor. The
exchange's prose is pronoun-free for {cast:buyer}. PATH chip on cs / s / sac,
anchored through the carrier ($actor) and $cast:buyer.
Extras          reputation_with $here +0.08 (step 1 success) / -0.10 (step 1 failure) /
-0.05 (step 0 failure: backs the critical_failure page on the step-0 route).
Cool failure?   Nobody is hurt, jailed or branded. A master's failure costs the name: the
town thinks less of their word on wool, because the guild sent them by name.
Trait hooks     Gate: none. Variant: Greedy (trait.personality.gold.vice) +0.04.
Trait-only nudge: none. Trait fragment: none.
Systems quota   cast + rewards + seeds + reputation — four.
Heavy Hand      none. Specials: Stir Suspicion (mind), Dull The Factor (entropy,
opposes buyer), Clean The Fleece (life), Steady The Scales (matter).
No card.boost.core special, no rider special, no compulsion.
─── The narrator's 12 questions, answered ───────────────────────────
1 P1 arrival?      {actor} arrives at the wool market in {location} on the last day of the
fair, sent by the wool guild.
2 P2 events?       The whole clip is for sale; the foreign buyers have agreed one price;
their factor holds them to it.
3 P3 one stake?    Threat: at the ring's price the shepherds cannot pay their rents.
4 ≤80 words?       Opening + step-0 spine: 75.
5 Read aloud?      Every sentence is a report.
6 Stated?          The ring, its price, its factor and the rent are stated.
7 Every sentence works? Challenge, test or outcome.
8 Nothing unintroduced? Ring, factor, buyers before step 0's cards; the mayor, the scales
and the weighing house in step 1's spine before its cards.
9 One named person? Step 0 {cast:buyer}; step 1 {cast:mayor}.
10 Stake in a sentence? 'Break the buyers' ring and sell the clip above their price before
the mayor closes the scales.'
11 Cards verb+noun? Yes; no name word repeated in its effect line; no digits.
12 Opening per class? urban, the only class, written.
A step-0 critical_failure ends the action, so that route carries only step 0's write
(town -0.05), which backs its one chip. successMetadata fires on near_miss too, so a
near-miss sale still pays the silk and plants the seed. Live proof needs pinned bands at
master difficulty.

template.name: The Wool Buyers' Ring

openings.urban: {actor} arrives at the wool market in {location} on the last day of the fair, sent by the wool guild.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
The town's whole year of wool, the clip, is for sale. The buyers from over the sea have agreed to bid one price and no higher. {cast:buyer}, the factor who speaks for the buyers, holds them to it.

At that price the shepherds cannot pay their rents. {actor} has to break the ring before the fair closes.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: Two buyers broke from the ring before noon, each asking for a private price.
steps.successAfterimage: One buyer broke from the ring and asked for a private price.
steps.nearMissAfterimage: One buyer agreed to bid above the ring, but only if the others did not see.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: One buyer broke from the ring, but {cast:buyer} saw which one.
steps.failureAfterimage: The ring held, and the buyers kept to their one price.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The ring held, and the buyers left the market to wait for the price to fall.

nudges.name: Stir Suspicion
nudges.effectLine: Wake each buyer's fear that another will break the ring first. Each one is tempted to seek a private sale.

bandProse.critical_success: Every buyer came to suspect the others of dealing in secret.
bandProse.success: The buyers began to watch each other instead of the wool.
bandProse.near_miss: The buyers eyed each other all morning, and no second buyer broke.
bandProse.failure: The buyers grew wary of each other, and still none would bid alone.

nudges.name: Dull The Factor
nudges.effectLine: Tire the ring's leader through the long fair day. They stop watching which buyer talks to whom.

bandProse.success: {cast:buyer} sat down in the afternoon heat and missed a buyer slipping off to the guild's table.
bandProse.success_at_cost: {cast:buyer} dozed in the afternoon heat and woke too soon.
bandProse.failure: {cast:buyer} nodded off, and the buyers stayed loyal with no one watching.
bandProse.critical_failure: {cast:buyer} grew tired and short-tempered, and threatened any buyer who left the ring.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
The sale is held in the weighing-house yard, with the guild's men on one side and the buyers on the other. {cast:mayor}, mayor of the wool market, weighs and seals each sack at the price agreed.

The scales close at sunset. {actor} must sell the whole clip above the ring's price by then. If the wool goes cheap, the town will blame the one the guild sent.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: The buyer who broke the ring bid high, and the others followed to keep their share. {cast:mayor} sealed every sack before sunset.
steps.successAfterimage: The buyers bid past the ring's price, and {cast:mayor} sealed every sack.
steps.nearMissAfterimage: The clip sold a little above the ring's price, and {cast:mayor} sealed it.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: The clip sold above the ring's price, but only because {cast:mayor} kept the scales open past sunset.
steps.failureAfterimage: {cast:mayor} sealed the clip at the ring's price.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The buyers walked away from the scales before the last sacks were weighed.

critical_success.text: Two buyers have broken from the ring.

success.text: One buyer has broken from the ring.

success_at_cost.text: The ring's factor knows who broke.

near_miss.text: The only buyer who broke wants it kept quiet.

effects.seedLabel: The factor of the broken wool ring comes to bid against {actor} again.

nudges.name: Clean The Fleece
nudges.effectLine: Make each bale open soft and white under the knife. Every buyer at the scales sees good wool.

bandProse.critical_success: Each bale opened clean and soft, and the buyers stopped haggling over quality.
bandProse.success: The wool opened clean, and the buyers paid for its quality.
bandProse.near_miss: The wool opened clean, but the buyers still bid low on the last bales.
bandProse.failure: The wool opened clean and soft, and the buyers would not pay a penny more for it.
bandProse.critical_failure: The buyers would not even cut the last bales open to look.

nudges.name: Steady The Scales
nudges.effectLine: Make every sack weigh true at the weighing house. No buyer can claim short weight to cut the price.

bandProse.success: The scales held true, and no buyer could claim short weight.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The weights held true, and the buyers argued every sack until dark.
bandProse.failure: The scales held true, and the buyers bargained the price down by the sack.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being Greedy, they can tell the most a buyer will pay.
